# Country

## Summary
Base-realm country field with a searchable picker edit UI. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/country` (default export `CountryField`).

## API
- `name` — country display name (StringField)
- `code` — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (StringField)

The module also exports a `Country` CardDef for realms that want countries
as linkable card instances rather than inline values.

## Usage
```ts
import CountryField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/country';

@field country = contains(CountryField);
```
Used by the base Address field for its country segment.
